newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH STOMIL SANOK SEES OVERSUBSCRIPTION OF IPO.
newsitem.headline: POLISH STOMIL SANOK SEES OVERSUBSCRIPTION OF IPO.

text.p: The 500,000 shares in the initial public offering of Polish rubber producer Stomil Sanok SA will likely be oversubscribed, the firm's president said on Friday.
"For the past few days there have been long lines (in front of brokerage houses), so I think the issue will end with success," Marek Lecki told Reuters, adding that he expected an oversubscription.

The firm, whose full name is Sanockie Zaklady Przemyslu Gumowego Stomil Sanok SA, offered its shares from November 4 to November 15 at 25 zlotys each and seeks to enter the main market of the Warsaw bourse at the turn of the year.
Lecki said the results of the subscription would likely be released on Monday.
The firm currently has 4.7 million shares, all of them approved for public trade.
